verdict.rationale: Close documents Custom Object Types that let you create arbitrary types with user-defined fields, and its custom-field definitions cover data type, multiplicity, edit permissions and sharing across Leads and Custom Activities. That covers the custom-object and field parts of the story. Nothing in the pack documents relationships between custom objects and built-in records, or between custom objects themselves. missing for 10: documented relationship/reference modeling for custom objects, depth of the custom object API (schemas, CRUD examples), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals

citations.quote: Custom Object Types let you create arbitrary types with user-defined fields.
you define its name, the type of data that's going to be stored on it, whether it can store multiple values or not, who in your organization can edit its values
a single Shared Custom Field can be assigned to Leads, and several different Custom Activities.
